flags: Rumion launched 2023-08-28 at Rs 10.29L (S MT) - 33 days before window start (2023-10-01); excluded from launches per rules, noted here for context. Deliveries began 2023-09-08.
Hyryder launched Sept 2022 and Innova Hycross launched Nov 2022 - both before the window; no launch events in-window for either.

Innova Crysta: 2026-06-04 update is explicitly described as a 'mild refresh'/'subtle design tweaks' (Team-BHP, Autocar, Moneycontrol) - judged NOT a Major facelift, so not recorded as a launch. Linked repricing (+Rs 32,000-83,000 vs outgoing, Autocar) recorded as price_changes. Likely last update before phase-out ~2027 (speculation, Autocar).
Ebella launch_type judgment: classified as 'New nameplate' (distinct new nameplate, Toyota's first EV in India). Could alternatively be read as an EV derivative of the shared e-Vitara platform.

Hyryder variant naming drift across sources: Jan 2024 sources used 'G'/'G AT'/'V AWD Manual (5MT)'; current verified names use 'G Opt'/'G Opt AT'/'V AWD AT'. Mapped to current verified names; the AWD gearbox changed from 5MT to 6AT in the 2025 MY update.

Hyryder GST variant table (caronphone, post-GST 2.0): conflicts with Oct 2026 official listed prices - e.g. table shows E at Rs 10,94,800 post-cut vs current official E at Rs 11,31,000. Either Toyota revised prices again after the cut or the portal table is stale. Records kept as is_estimate=true; cross-check before use.

Hycross GST variant-level: per-variant post-cut ex-showroom prices not cleanly sourced; only model-level 'Rs 55,196-1.15L depending on variant' (v3cars) available. Note: v3cars Jun-2026 list prices (G FLT 7S Rs 18.70L) match Oct-2026 verified prices, suggesting possible simultaneous base-price adjustments - unresolved.
Crysta Jan 2024 hike (+Rs 25,000 on VX/ZX; range Rs 19.99-26.30L): per-variant new prices not cleanly sourced; omitted from price_changes.
Hyryder Jan 2024: S CNG and G CNG got +Rs 15,000 but new prices not published in sourced articles; omitted from price_changes.

Taisor July 2025 entry price Rs 7,77,000 is the rounded figure reported by GaadiWaadi (launch E Rs 7.73L + Rs 2,500 flat hike); per-variant launch prices for S/S Plus/G/V not sourced, so only the entry variant recorded.
Rumion 'E' variant (Rs 9,79,000 in Oct 2026 verified data) was not in the 2025 S/G/V lineups; its introduction date is unsourced - not recorded as a launch (variant addition).
Hycross GX(O) trims and ZX (O) LE are post-launch variant additions/special editions - excluded from launches per rules.

Jan 2024 effective dates use 2024-01-01 (sources say 'effective from/beginning of January 2024'); March 2025, April 2025 and July 2025 events use month-start where sources give only the month. See per-record notes.

launches.notes: Urban Cruiser Taisor launched 2024-04-03; rebadged Maruti Fronx, 6th Toyota-Maruti shared model; 1.0L turbo / 1.2L petrol / E-CNG; bookings open at launch, deliveries from May 2024. Entry E MT. Price also reported as Rs 7,73,500 by Latestly; Delhi ex-showroom assumed.

Urban Cruiser Ebella: Toyota's first EV in India. Unveiled 2026-01-20 (bookings opened same day); price announced 2026-05-29 for sole E3 61kWh variant (172bhp, 543km claimed range); dealer arrivals mid-June 2026, deliveries started ~2026-06-18. Lower E1/E2 variants unpriced at launch. Classified as New nameplate (distinct new nameplate) rather than EV derivative.

model_notes.note: GST 2.0 (effective 2026-09-22): Toyota passed on the full tax benefit; Hyryder cheaper by up to Rs 65,400 depending on variant (Toyota announcement via Zee Business/Rushlane). Tax slab moved 45% to 40% (Hyryder >4m, engine up to 1500cc incl. hybrids).

GST 2.0 (effective 2026-09-22): Hycross received a price cut of Rs 55,196 to Rs 1.15 lakh depending on variant (v3cars). Toyota headline figure: up to Rs 1,15,800 (Zee Business). Slab moved 50% to 40%.
GST 2.0 (effective 2026-09-22): Crysta cheaper by up to Rs 1,80,600 (Toyota headline figure via Zee Business). Slab moved 50% to 40% (diesel >1500cc, >4m).

July 2025: VX and ZX variants hiked by Rs 26,000 (range Rs 19.99-27.08L ex-showroom); Crysta was among three Toyota models hiked that month (GaadiWaadi). Per-variant new prices not published; recorded as note only.
GST 2.0 (effective 2026-09-22): Rumion cheaper by up to Rs 48,700 (Toyota headline figure via Zee Business). Slab moved 45% to 40%.
GST 2.0 (effective 2026-09-22): Taisor cheaper by up to Rs 1,11,100 (Toyota headline figure via Zee Business). Sub-4m petrol slab moved 29% to 18%.
No price changes documented in the window after the 2026-05-29 launch pricing. EV GST unchanged at 5% under GST 2.0, so no tax-driven revision.
